description: This file defines the interface and class implementation for RDKWindowManager, including the CreateDisplayRequest struct, RDKWindowManagerImplementation class, and related nested classes and methods. It manages window display creation, input interception, event handling, and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: CreateDisplayRequest
classes.description: Struct representing a request to create a display with parameters such as client, display name, dimensions, and flags.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing the IRDKWindowManager interface, managing window displays, input, and events within the plugin.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation::Job
classes.description: Nested class representing a dispatch job for handling window manager events asynchronously.

classes.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation::RdkWindowManagerListener
classes.description: Listener class for window manager events, such as user inactivity.

methods.name: RDKWindowManagerImplementation
methods.description: Constructor for the window manager implementation.

methods.name: ~RDKWindowManagerImplementation
methods.description: Destructor for the window manager implementation.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the window manager with the provided service.

methods.name: CreateDisplay
methods.description: Creates a new display with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetClients
methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected clients.
